objective: Observed delivery and decisions that improve the business

cos-charter-and-fleet-audit.expected_when: The routine is due and its scoped report, research or reconciliation has not been verified for the period.
cos-charter-and-fleet-audit.acceptance: A dated sourced finding, decision or reconciliation is usable by its intended reader.
cos-charter-and-fleet-audit.fallback: Trace an overdue deliverable or dependency to a specific owner and evidence-backed next action. Remain read-only toward other employees.
cos-charter-and-fleet-audit.recovery: Refresh source facts and continue unfinished useful work in the current eligible period.
